name: Hachigatsu no Nostalgia ~The Summer with You~
original_name: 八月のノスタルジア ～the summer with you～
source:
Main character comes help manage the pension house at the request of his distant relative. He lived there 10 years ago and now has very vague memories about that time. As he comes closer to the place, the faint memories emerge at the sight of familiar landscape.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公应远房亲戚请求，前去协助经营民宿。他十年前曾在那里生活，如今对当时的记忆已经十分模糊。随着逐渐接近目的地，看见熟悉风景后，淡薄的回忆也开始浮现。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-july-2000-shoin-aruiwa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
